evidence.quote: Decision: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer.

observations.why: Explicit ratification language ('Decision:') performs the settling of a position the speaker expects the suite to act on; the performed declarative carries decision-grade conviction.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion.

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertion of the probe's purpose, subordinate to and reinforcing the prior decision but not itself performing a new settling — claim-level conviction.
